items.title: Håkan Rydin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016
items.q: Some don’t know who Oscar Peterson is.

ctx.x: Do the students who come to you now know more than they used to?

Well I think it differs very, very much, between individuals. First of all their knowledge of history differs. Some know everything, and some know nothing. Some don’t know who Oscar Peterson is. Some know more than me about history and can compete for record deals. So it’s a big difference. And I don’t think it’s changed so much over the years. They’re good.
Do you like the fact that everything is available to them through the internet and so forth?
